findings.claim: IBM i 授權由永久授權轉為訂閱制（Power10 P05/P10 自 2024-05 起買硬體須訂閱授權，延伸至 Power11）
findings.source: 2-data.com IBM i's Perpetual Licence Era Is Over
findings.excerpt: of subscription-based licensing became mandatory starting in May 2024, with that requirement now extending naturally into the current IBM Power11 generation. Why This Matters More on Power11 Than It Did on Power10 The subscription requirement was easier to overlook when it applied narrowly to specific Power10 tier machines, since many organisations simply continued running existing perpetually

findings.claim: Think 2026 主題演講：IBM 合作夥伴分 Sell／Build／Service 三種角色；分析師認為以成交付費的夥伴方案與夥伴經濟錯位
findings.source: Techaisle IBM partner ecosystem curation doctrine Think 2026
findings.excerpt: Yusuf's keynote built the partner story on three personas: the Sell Partner, the Build Partner, and the Service Partner. The framing matters because it organizes the entire ecosystem investment portfolio around what partners actually do, not what they resell.

findings.claim: Ingram Micro 不再擔任 IBM 澳紐經銷商，轉向以服務與軟體為主的新夥伴
findings.source: Channel Insider IBM shuffles ANZ distribution to support MSP play
findings.excerpt: it has brought on NEXTGEN Group and Arrow Electronics to act as its distributors in Australia. Meanwhile, Melbourne-based Meier Business Systems will handle the company’s hardware and technology life cycle services. The big change to the channel blend here is that Ingram Micro will no longer be a distributor for IBM in Australia.
